### [![Download Blazify for Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download_Blazify_9.16.0-FFA726?style=for-the-badge&logoColor=1A0E00&logo=android)](https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/releases/latest/download/Blazify-gms.apk) **One click. No choosing.** That button gives you the build for an ordinary phone: everything Blazify does, casting to a Chromecast, a smart speaker or a television included, and it tells you when there is a new version. On a phone with no Google services — de-Googled, LineageOS, a Huawei — take [Blazify.apk](https://github.com/rajendra7169/blazify/releases/latest/download/Blazify.apk) below instead: the same app, without playing to a television.
--- ## Highlights - **Video Art player** — the song's own official video plays behind the player, muted and in step with the audio. It stays off on mobile data unless you ask for it - **Import a playlist from Spotify** — paste a share link and Blazify rebuilds it, song by song - **Skip the talking** — SponsorBlock skips intros, outros and non-music sections, and the lyrics shift with it so the words still match - **Radio stations play** — the live broadcasts in Listen together now work, marked LIVE while they are on air - **Block an artist** and they stay out of Home, search, picks and radio - Sideways works: every player design, the theme gallery and Look & Feel are laid out for a phone on its side - The app is now translated into 15 more languages ## New features - **Swipe a song in the queue to the right** to play it next — no dragging it up eighty places - **Share a playlist** as a link or a QR code; opening one offers to keep it - **Jump to the playing song** in a long playlist, album or library list - **Play this a few times** — repeat a song 2, 3, 5 or 10 times, then carry on - **ListenBrainz** scrobbling, beside Last.fm - Speed dial and For you play straight from the greeting card on Home - Updates download inside the app now, with a progress bar, instead of handing the file to a browser - The queue got a proper look: one-line header, rounded artwork, amber shuffle and repeat, and it fades into the bar at the foot - Lyrics: the pill at the top is called **Sources**, because that is what it opens — the same words from every provider, so you can take whichever is best in time. It steps out of the way in full screen - Settings shows who is signed in, with your channel picture ## Fixes and improvements - **Keep playing through a connection drop** — minutes of the song are fetched ahead, and a lost connection is picked up when it returns - Search shows results as soon as YouTube answers instead of waiting for artist lookups — about three times quicker - A song is put on top of the results when YouTube leads with a video of it - Artist names are read properly: no more songs by "4:41", "2026" or "," - Downloads that did not finish are asked for again at startup, and a failed one says so - Songs on your phone play straight off the phone, with their own covers kept - A song that loads but never starts is skipped instead of buffering for ever - The play button takes its colour from the artwork on every design, and the duplicate cast button is gone from the album art - The sleep timer opens as a sheet like the keys beside it, not a box in the middle of the screen - Fixed a crash that could kill the app at launch after the sideways work --- **Also on this page:** `Blazify.apk` for phones without Google services, and `Blazify-izzy-9.16.0.apk`, the build with no updater for F-Droid-style repositories.
